tool: OWASP ZAP (Zed Attack Proxy) Dynamic Security Audit Suite

alerts.name: X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing
alerts.description: X-Content-Type-Options header is missing. Browsers may attempt to MIME-sniff response content.

alerts.name: Server Version / Banner Disclosure
alerts.description: Server discloses web server technology via 'Server: Kestrel'. Attackers can fingerprint the host.

alerts.name: Cross-Domain CORS Misconfiguration
alerts.description: CORS policy reflects arbitrary origins or uses wildcard: '*'. Sensitive data may be accessible cross-origin.

alerts.name: Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Missing
alerts.description: Content-Security-Policy header is missing on frontend. Recommended to restrict inline script execution and XSS vectors.
alerts.evidence: CSP header absent on React web root.

alerts.name: X-Frame-Options Clickjacking Protection
alerts.description: X-Frame-Options header missing. The application could be embedded in an iframe on third-party sites.
alerts.evidence: X-Frame-Options header absent on web portal.

alerts.name: Rate Limiting on Authentication Endpoint
alerts.description: All 25 requests processed in 0.34s without HTTP 429 rate limit trigger. Recommendation: Add ASP.NET Core RateLimiter middleware to protect against brute-force attacks.

allTests.name: Invalid Credentials Rejection
allTests.description: System strictly rejects incorrect authentication credentials without revealing specific reason.

allTests.name: JWT 'alg: none' Signature Bypass Resistance
allTests.description: ASP.NET Core JWT middleware strictly validates digital HMAC signatures and rejects unsigned 'alg: none' tokens.
allTests.evidence: Returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized for forged token.

allTests.name: Missing Authentication Token Barrier
allTests.description: Protected endpoints require valid Bearer token and reject unauthenticated requests with HTTP 401.
allTests.evidence: All tested protected endpoints returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

allTests.name: Driver Access to Staff POS Endpoint (BFLA)
allTests.description: ASP.NET Core policy authorization successfully rejected Driver attempting to create on-site walk-in reservations.

allTests.name: Driver Self-Approval Protection
allTests.description: Driver role is strictly prohibited from approving reservations; requires StationOwner or Admin role.

allTests.name: Registration Input Validation
allTests.description: Registration rejected malformed or unpermitted role payload with status 400.

allTests.name: SQL Injection Parameter Resilience (EF Core Parameterization)
allTests.description: Station search and filter queries use Entity Framework Core parameterized SQL. No SQL syntax errors or database exceptions were triggered.
allTests.evidence: All SQLi probes safely handled without error leakage.

allTests.name: Reflected XSS Input Sanitization
allTests.description: XSS characters are safely encoded or returned as strict JSON content-type, preventing browser execution.

allTests.name: Standardized Problem Details Error Handling
allTests.description: Server utilizes ASP.NET Core RFC 7807/9110 Problem Details for errors, suppressing raw stack traces.

allTests.name: Sensitive Credential Masking in DTOs
allTests.description: Application DTOs strictly exclude PasswordHash and authentication secrets from API serialization.
allTests.evidence: PasswordHash properly excluded from profile response.

allTests.name: Rate Limiting on Authentication Endpoint
allTests.description: All 25 requests processed in 0.34s without HTTP 429 rate limit trigger. Recommendation: Add ASP.NET Core RateLimiter middleware to protect against brute-force attacks.
